notes: מִנֶּגֶד fused as one compound preposition under rule 30's one-rendering condition, headed on against; the split reading (over to מִן, against to נֶגֶד) is named in that unit's note.
סָבִיב takes the whole compound round about and the following לְ is unrepresented — the construction rule 40 cites by name.
Both occurrences of יַחֲנוּ are separately written and separately rendered, so rule 22 does not reach either.
